newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-G&K long-term rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-G&K long-term rating cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it reduced its long-term six-to-18-month rating on G&K Services Inc to market performer from outperform based solely on valuation.

--"Using our estimates of $1.37 for FY97 (June) and $1.37 for FY98, the shares are now trading at a 40 percent premium (based on calendar 1997 earnings) to the S&P 500 and slightly above the 10-year average relative range of a 10-35 percent premium," said EVEREN in a report.
